lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: The Tree House. Peppa and George are visiting Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig.
lines.zh: 树屋。佩奇和乔治去猪奶奶和猪爷爷家做客。

lines.en: Before you come in the house, you must take off your muddy boots. Yes, Granny.
lines.zh: 进屋之前，你们必须把沾泥的靴子脱掉。好的，奶奶。

lines.en: Peppa, George, look what I've made. Little curtains! Ooh! What are the little curtains for, Granny? It's a surprise.
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，看我做了什么。小窗帘！哦！奶奶，这些小窗帘是做什么用的？这是个惊喜。

lines.en: Do you want to see what Grandpa Pig has made for you in the garden? Yes, please!
lines.zh: 你们想看看猪爷爷在花园里给你们做了什么吗？想！

lines.en: Hello, Peppa, George. Look what I made for you: a tree house!
lines.zh: 你们好，佩奇，乔治。看我给你们做了什么：一座树屋！

lines.en: A tree house! For George and me! And the little curtains are for your tree house!
lines.zh: 树屋！给乔治和我的！那些小窗帘是给你们树屋用的！

lines.en: Peppa and George love their tree house. Thank you, Granny Pig! Thank you, Grandpa Pig!
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢他们的树屋。谢谢你，猪奶奶！谢谢你，猪爷爷！

lines.en: Who wants to go inside first? Me! Me! In you go, then.
lines.zh: 谁想第一个进去？我！我！那你们进去吧。

lines.en: Before I go in my tree house, I must take off my muddy boots. I'm in my tree house!
lines.zh: 进树屋之前，我得先把沾泥的靴子脱掉。我在我的树屋里面啦！

lines.en: I'm in my tree house! George, would you like to go in the tree house, too? Yes!
lines.zh: 我在我的树屋里面啦！乔治，你也想进树屋吗？想！

lines.en: Who is it? A young pig named George would like to pay a visit. Can he come in?
lines.zh: 是谁呀？一只叫乔治的小猪想来拜访。他能进来吗？

lines.en: As long as he takes off his muddy boots! George, take your boots off, then you can visit Peppa in the tree house.
lines.zh: 只要他把沾泥的靴子脱掉就行！乔治，把靴子脱了，你就可以去树屋找佩奇了。

lines.en: Who is it? George. Yes? Who is it? It's Mummy Pig. Have you room for any more visitors? Hmm, you have to say the secret words, then you can come into our house.
lines.zh: 是谁呀？是乔治。什么事？是谁呀？我是猪妈妈。你们还容得下别的客人吗？嗯，你得说出暗号，然后才能进我们的房子。

lines.en: I see. And what are the secret words? I have to whisper them to you. The secret words are: Daddy's big tummy!
lines.zh: 我明白了。那暗号是什么呢？我得悄悄告诉你。暗号是：爸爸的大肚子！

lines.en: I see. Say the secret words. Daddy's big tummy! That's right, Daddy's big tummy!
lines.zh: 我明白了。说出暗号吧。爸爸的大肚子！没错，爸爸的大肚子！

lines.en: I think those are silly secret words.
lines.zh: 我觉得这个暗号真傻。

lines.en: Oh, Mummy, before you come in our house, you must take off your boots! Of course!
lines.zh: 哦，妈妈，进我们房子之前，你必须把靴子脱掉！当然啦！

lines.en: There's room for Daddy, too. Say the secret words, Daddy.
lines.zh: 爸爸也有位置。爸爸，说出暗号吧。

lines.en: Can I have different secret words, please? No, no. Oh, all right. Daddy's big tummy! That's right. You can come in right now, Daddy. Take your boots off!
lines.zh: 请问我能换个暗号吗？不行，不行。哦，好吧。爸爸的大肚子！答对了。爸爸，你现在就可以进来了。把靴子脱掉！

lines.en: I don't think I can fit through the door. That's because your tummy's too big! I know, Daddy Pig can climb in through the top!
lines.zh: 我觉得我挤不进门。那是因为你的肚子太大了！我知道了，猪爸爸可以从顶上爬进去！

lines.en: Peppa, George, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are all in the tree house.
lines.zh: 佩奇、乔治、猪妈妈和猪爸爸全都在树屋里了。

lines.en: Granny, I love our tree house. I don't want to ever come out!
lines.zh: 奶奶，我喜欢我们的树屋。我永远都不想出来了！

lines.en: That's nice, Peppa, but are you sure you don't want to visit me in my house? No, thank you, Granny.
lines.zh: 那很好呀，佩奇，不过你确定不想去我家玩吗？不了，谢谢奶奶。

lines.en: In that case, Grandpa Pig and I will just have to eat my homemade cookies all by ourselves.
lines.zh: 既然这样，那我和猪爷爷就只能自己吃掉我亲手做的饼干了。

lines.en: Cookies!
lines.zh: 饼干！

lines.en: Granny Pig, here are my homemade cookies. But if you want to come in, you have to say the secret words.
lines.zh: 猪奶奶，我亲手做的饼干在这儿。不过如果你们想进来，就得说出暗号。

lines.en: That's easy. Daddy's big tummy! That's right!
lines.zh: 这简单。爸爸的大肚子！答对了！

lines.en: Well, I still think that those are very silly secret words.
lines.zh: 哼，我还是觉得这个暗号傻透了。
